title: Hexana target runtimes
description: Runtimes and versions this project has to run on. Hexana checks every WebAssembly binary against them and warns about proposals a declared runtime cannot run. Read and written by both the IntelliJ plugin and the VS Code extension.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema. Written by Hexana; safe to leave alone.

version.description: Format version of this file. Currently 1.

targets.description: The runtimes to check against, in the order they appear as columns in the Compatibility tab. An empty list means no checking is performed.

runtime.description: Runtime name, spelled as WebAssembly's own features.json spells it ("Chrome", "Node.js", "Wasmtime"). A name the catalog does not know has no support data, so every verdict for it reads "?".

version.description: Version being targeted, as a string ("120", "26.0"). Omit it to target any version, which applies no version gate.
